title: sbmlab-benchmarks: scripts and results behind the measured posts on sbmlab.com
description: Scripts, settings and result tables behind the measured bioinformatics posts on sbmlab.com: proteomics known-ratio benchmarks on PRIDE PXD028735 (MaxQuant 2.8.1, FragPipe 24, DIA-NN 2.3.2), DIA-NN 2.7.0 vs 2.3.2, replicate CV in the three engines, DIA-NN quantification modes (QuantUMS, legacy and fragment-level MaxLFQ), limma vs DEqMS, imputation, STRING confidence scores and hub proteins, STRING enrichment background, a 3 vs 3 t-test vs limma simulation, WGCNA on CPTAC ccRCC proteomics, biomarker data leakage, mRNA vs protein (Wang 2019), database APIs, DESeq2/edgeR/limma, Scanpy PBMC3k and BioMart orthologues. Raw data are not included; see README for sources.
